title: Figuring Out the Format of Dinotopia
content: I first mocked up Dinotopia as a “Grand Tour of a Lost World,” structured like a travel guide. I was inspired by the lavishly illustrated books from the Dutch artist Rien Poortvliet. (His are ALL good.)But novel-length picture books were rare in the book business. And I kept hitting the same problem: how do you frame a lost continent story?More on Substack
